import numpy as np
T=t;X=x;V=v;Y=dv_dt
one=np.ones_like(T)
base=np.column_stack([one,X,V,V*V,V**3,X*X,X*V])
def scan(fn,grid,label):
    best=(9,0)
    for w in grid:
        B=np.column_stack([base,fn(w)])
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,Y,rcond=None)[0]
        r=np.mean((B@c-Y)**2)/np.var(Y)
        if r<best[0]: best=(r,w,c)
    print(label,best[0],best[1],np.round(best[2],3))
